  Scenario: AC7 Each business rule BR1 to BR9 is asserted by at least one scenario of this section (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the run report is produced for the wave 4 closure run
    When the harness checks the business rules of section 8
    Then every rule BR1 to BR9 is listed with the scenario that asserts it
    And a rule with no asserting scenario fails the run

  Scenario: AC8 A redelivered state-change event is consumed once and writes no second closing entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case is closed and its state-change event is published a second time
    When the test consumer drains the topic with its cutoff
    Then the case stays in "CASE_CLOSED" with its original closed_date
    And there is one closing entry and one ledger entry for the close
    And the run reports the duplicate publication as a failure

  Scenario: AC9 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case in state "PLACED_WITH_AGENCY"
    When a status change to "CASE_CLOSED" is requested without passing "RETENTION_RUNNING"
    Then the change is refused
    And the case stays in "PLACED_WITH_AGENCY" and nothing is written on the case
